pages.text: A cluster of mods adds blocks that look at home beside Create machines. Most are purely decorative, a few change how Create builds.

pages.title: Create Deco
pages.text: Metal and brick decor: catwalks, bars, cage lamps, coin stacks, shipping containers and train hulls. Bricks come in several colours and cracked or tiled forms.

pages.title: Design n' Decor
pages.text: Industrial set dressing: sheet metal, large metal girders, containers, large fans, bolts and display boards, in many colours.

pages.title: Copycats+
pages.text: Copycat blocks take on the look of any block you apply: slices, layers, doors, fences, plates, cogwheels, shafts. Replaces the copycats Create: Connected has switched off.

pages.title: Create: Framed
pages.text: Framed and tiled stained glass, plus cardboard blocks and peephole panes. Many colours and connected-texture variants.

pages.title: Create Encased
pages.text: More casings for shafts, cogwheels, pipes and gearboxes. Pure variety; they keep the same function as Create's own.

pages.title: Create: Connected
pages.text: Functional blocks: six-way gearbox, clutches, kinetic bridge and battery, fan catalysts. Its own copycats are off; old ones migrate to Copycats+.
